intro: Edit every piece of static text on the public site (Dental Web) — the nav, footer, and other pages as they get migrated. Each language shows as its own column; "Translate with AI" drafts a suggestion you can edit before saving.

languages.title: Site Languages
languages.removeConfirmBody: Every translation in "{label}" will be permanently deleted. The public site will keep working normally in the other languages.
languages.setDefaultConfirmBody: "{label}" will become the site's default language — what new visitors see first and the source language "Translate with AI" translates from. Existing text isn't changed.

translateAll.confirmBody: Translates every empty field in "{group}" from the default language into the other languages and saves it immediately. Existing translations are never overwritten.
translateAll.none: Nothing to translate — every field already has a translation
